text: I recommend that the bakery launch the new sourdough line. The kitchen has already implemented allergen isolation protocols to minimize risk, and the line will utilize a heritage grain blend, which is known for its rich flavor profile. Additionally, the line has had a successful six-month run, selling out for six consecutive months after launch. This track record suggests that the sourdough line will offer a loyal customer base and attract new customers. A bulk flour discount would also contribute to cost savings, which will help maintain profitability. Overall, the combination of a reliable and successful recipe, favorable ingredient costs, and a strong customer base makes the new sourdough line a solid choice.
